pricing: Free (no ads) incl. full tracker and 11,000+ programs; Pro $59.99/yr (7-day trial) or $14.99/mo. Paywalled: Strength Score, volume heatmap, AI/personalized programs, Pro auto-progression, 20+ exclusive coach programs, advanced analytics, bodyweight tracker, progress photos.
platforms: iOS (iPhone, iPad), Android, web (program creator + history); no Apple Watch app
positioning: Program-first strength app: popular coach/Reddit programs (5/3/1, nSuns, GZCLP, PPL...) with built-in progression logic, wrapped in a free tracker.

features.how: Sets log weight x reps (+ optional RPE/RIR); timed exercises can be programmed in minutes/seconds; AMRAP sets supported in programs. Distance metrics not documented (app is strength-focused, little cardio).
features.user_feedback: App Store review: desktop creator can't switch an exercise's duration from minutes to seconds (mobile only).

features.how: Tap the set number to mark it Work, Warm-up, Drop or Failure set; drop sets can be added to any working set.
Every set has optional RPE (5-10) and RIR fields, free; stored for fatigue trends across a block and RPE-based programs.
Logging screen shows a 'previous' column with last session's (previous week's, in programs) sets, reps and weight; exercise detail shows past performance and PRs.
features.user_feedback: App Store reviews: previous weights sometimes missing (e.g. OHP in Candito program); wish it saved rep counts too.

features.how: Tap the previous column to copy weight/reps into today's set; program auto-progression pre-loads next session's weights (bumps after hitting reps, adjusts down after misses).
Workout notes (general) plus exercise-specific notes (Dec 2024); programs carry coach notes per day/week.
Group exercises into supersets in the workout editor and program creator.
Not documented.

Swap icon shows coach-suggested alternatives (or '•••' to pick any exercise); weights carry over to the substitute and the app asks whether to apply the swap only today or to future workouts. 'Similar Exercises' recommendations for every exercise added Oct 2026.
features.user_feedback: Play Store review (Feb 2025): some substitution functions locked behind subscription; App Store review: only about half of 'save for future' swaps stick.

features.how: Free plate calculator tells which plates to load on each side of the bar for each set.
Customizable warm-up set templates that can be applied to any working weight and saved/reused (now free; an older review says warm-up sets were Premium).
Bodyweight exercises supported; logging added/assisted load not documented.
Not documented.
Not documented.
Start a freestyle/empty workout without a program; Pro auto-progression also works with empty workouts (v266).
History tab lists past workouts (view by month since v265) and lets you open one and save it as a template; editing/backdating finished sessions is not documented.
Tap a set to log it and the rest timer starts; since v265 (Sep 2026) the current set stays highlighted and finished exercises collapse; swipe left to delete a set/exercise.
Rest timer auto-starts when a set is logged.
Rest time is set per exercise/set in the program creator; timers can be toggled per movement.
features.user_feedback: App Store review: had to turn the timer off again every week for some movements.

features.how: Not documented beyond Live Activities.
Live Activities put the current set and rest timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island (iOS).
Exercises can be prescribed by duration (minutes/seconds); a dedicated set stopwatch/countdown UI is not documented.
Reports show number of workouts and minutes trained over time.
Not documented.
features.user_feedback: Older reviews (2023-2025): completed workout not registered (next day repeats) and freezes on the 'complete workout' summary screen.

features.how: Single-day workout templates under 'All Templates'; any past workout in History can be saved as a template.
No folders documented; since v263 (Jul 2026) 'Save' bookmarks coach/user programs into one tab.

Core of the app: 11,000+ programs incl. 130+ coach-designed (Wendler 5/3/1, nSuns, GZCLP, PHUL/PHAT, Reddit PPL, Sheiko, Candito, Helms, Nuñez...), filterable by level, goal, days/week; ~20 coach programs are Pro-exclusive. You can join multiple programs at once.

Programs encode percentages of training max, AMRAP targets, waves and deloads; you enter starting lifts and weights are calculated weekly. Custom builder supports multi-week mesocycles and training-max waves.

'AI Coach' / personalized programs: short questionnaire (goal, experience, schedule, equipment) builds a multi-week starter periodization plan you can edit (Pro); 'Create programs with AI' added Mar 2026.
Planner icon shows scheduled workouts across all weeks of a program; app proposes the next day in sequence; push notifications preview next workout and calendar invites are available.
Custom programs can be shared via private link (recipient taps Save) or published to the community library; programs can be forked.
Program creator advertises 500+ searchable exercises; web exercise guide pages cover only 30 exercises across 6 equipment types.
Tap an exercise to see a demo, past performance and PRs; reviewers say demos are animations rather than full coaching videos (marketing says 'form videos').
features.user_feedback: GGR and Fortune: instruction is thin for beginners.

features.how: Custom exercises allowed, free, no cap.
Exercise guide shows body parts worked; programs show a muscle breakdown per workout (Dec 2024); muscle-group engagement analytics.
Exercises are categorized by equipment (barbell, dumbbell, kettlebell, machine, bodyweight, cable) on the web guide; in-app filtering not documented.
Exercise search in the program creator; programs can be searched by exercise (Mar 2026).
App Store lists English as the only language.

Free: program-defined auto-progression (coach rules / % of training max) fills next weights, bumps after hitting reps and adjusts down after misses. Pro (v266, Oct 2026): 'Auto Progression' personalized weight targets based on performance, for programs and empty workouts.
Available only if the chosen program encodes it; no generic double-progression setting documented.
Deloads are built into coach programs' schedules; no reactive, fatigue-triggered deload.
No readiness/recovery model; Pro shows RPE drift and volume trends only.
'AI Coach' builds a customized multi-week program from a questionnaire; no conversational coaching or form feedback (reviewers: 'no individualized coaching').

Automatic PRs: max weight per rep range, max volume per session, max reps at a weight, 'Max Weight Reps', e1RM, lifetime bests; flagged in-session with confetti and badge; PRs can be reset to a new baseline while keeping history (v262).
e1RM curve calculated from top sets; formula not published.
Basic strength progress charts free; Pro adds advanced per-exercise analytics (volume trends, intensity distribution, frequency, RPE drift).
Weekly Sunday report (free) lists PRs, weekly volume by muscle group, adherence and workouts; total weight lifted per week shown.
Pro: front/back body diagram colored by volume per muscle with 7/30/90-day and yearly views.
History viewable by month; consistency messages; explicit streak counter not documented.
Post-workout summary with muscles hit, PR badges and share-with-friends step.
Pro 'Strength Score' 0-100 from lifetime PRs on squat, bench, deadlift, OHP and row, bodyweight-normalized with IPF DOTS.
Bodyweight Tracker (Pro, Dec 2024); bodyweight syncs with Apple Health (v264, Aug 2026).
Not documented.
Progress photos listed among Pro data by Garage Gym Reviews.
No sleep/HRV/check-in features mentioned anywhere; app logs effort only via RPE/RIR.
Writes workouts and syncs bodyweight with Apple Health (v264).

Equipment is an input to the AI/personalized program questionnaire; programs can be customized with swaps; reviewers say you can tell the app what equipment you have.
Community tab (v263, Jul 2026): follow friends, like/comment on logged workouts; photo + caption posts (v265).
Share workouts, program links, year-end Wrapped; invite friends to start a program together.
Reviewers note no leaderboards or competitions.
No competitions/challenges per testers.
No client dashboard; reviewers stress there is no individual coaching or coach access.
Anyone can build a program 'for someone you train' on the web creator and send a private link; client tracking is not provided.
No coach feedback loop; only community program reviews/results.
No chat function.
Program library from 50+ named coaches (some Pro-exclusive), with user reviews/results on program pages; not a hire-a-coach marketplace.

Free tier (no ads claimed) with full logger, 11,000+ programs, RPE/RIR, plate calc, PRs, weekly reports, unlimited custom programs. Pro $59.99/yr with 7-day trial or $14.99/mo without trial (App Store also shows $11.99-$79.99 variants and $48.99 offers): Strength Score, heatmap, AI programs, 20+ exclusive programs, advanced analytics, bodyweight tracker, Pro auto-progression.
features.user_feedback: GGR: recommends Pro to unlock data/charts; Play review: basic substitution paywalled; App Store review: dark mode used to be paid.

Dark mode (made free after previously being Premium, per user reviews).

features.how: Account required; App Store privacy: identifiers used for tracking/third-party advertising; email/name collected. Play: may share personal info with third parties.
Free Sunday report: PRs hit, weekly volume per muscle, adherence, workout list; lifetime report too.
Annual 'Wrapped' recap of the training year, shareable (free).
Desktop program creator: map all weeks, 500+ exercises, sets/reps/rest/loading, supersets, RPE, AMRAP, drop sets; saves instantly to the app.
Some programs offer variations on join (e.g. Nuñez Upper Lower: arms/delts, chest/back, quad or glute-ham dominant); program pages carry user reviews/results; 'similar programs' suggestions.
Fork any library program and edit it as your own.
Users can join multiple programs simultaneously and pull a day from another program.
